children: Three wheeler manufacturer Atul Auto reported a 34% year-on-year increase in revenue to ₹268 crore for the second quarter of FY27, compared with ₹200 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. However its net profit declined 27% to ₹6.7 crore from ₹9.2 crore a year ago.
Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) also fell 25% to ₹14 crore from ₹19 crore, while EBITDA margin stood at 5.2% against 9.2% in Q2 FY26.
Atul Auto said that it sold 11,916 three-wheelers during the September quarter, compared with 9,248 units in the corresponding period last year, registering a growth of approximately 28.8%.
For the first half of FY27, three-wheeler sales increased 34.7% to 21,794 units from 16,177 units in H1 FY26.
For the half year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations increased to ₹486.74 crore from ₹352.95 crore in the corresponding period last year.
Consolidated profit before tax (PBT) rose to ₹19.76 crore from ₹14.85 crore, while profit after tax (PAT) increased to ₹14.88 crore from ₹10.33 crore, registering growth of approximately 44%.
The company attributed its first-half performance to higher three-wheeler sales volumes and contributions from its automobile and financial services businesses.
Shares of Atul Auto ended 2.07% lower at ₹411 on the NSE on October 30.

title: Atul Auto Q2 result: Profit falls 27% despite 34% revenue growth
